versions.subject: Add Hide Service Via SDDL Rule
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'pwsh.dll'
selection_sddl:
    # Example would be: "D:(D;;DCLCWPDTSD;;;IU)(D;;DCLCWPDTSD;;;SU)(D;;DCLCWPDTSD;;;BA)(A;;CCLCSWLOCRRC;;;IU)(A;;CCLCSWLOCRRC;;;SU)(A;;CCLCSWRPWPDTLOCRRC;;;SY)(A;;CCDCLCSWRPWPDTLOCRSDRCWDWO;;;BA)S:(AU;FA;CCDCLCSWRPWPDTLOCRSDRCWDWO;;;WD)"
    CommandLine|contains: 'DCLCWPDTSD'
selection_cmdlet:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-SecurityDescriptorSddl '
        - '-sd '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\pwsh.exe" OR OriginalFileName="pwsh.dll" CommandLine="*DCLCWPDTSD*" CommandLine IN ("*-SecurityDescriptorSddl *", "*-sd *")
